title: Industry Interchange & Layer-Aware Roundtrip
objective: Add capability-filtered import/export/roundtrip for appropriate open/standard or independently supported formats, including layer-aware raster interchange, PDF/e-book style outputs where applicable and preservation of editable text/layer semantics when the format supports them. Private/proprietary formats require independently lawful support; no undocumented reverse-engineered dependency is assumed.
acceptance: Interchange format support is explicit and capability-filtered; unsupported or proprietary/private formats fail closed unless independently lawful/documented support exists.
Layer-aware raster interchange preserves stable project/page/panel/layer identity and editable layer semantics whenever the selected format supports them.
Editable text semantics are preserved when the selected interchange format supports editable text; unsupported semantics degrade explicitly rather than silently flattening owner truth.
PDF/e-book style outputs are governed export projections only and do not themselves authorize publication, upload, distribution or commercial release.
Roundtrip import/export retains explicit source/version/provenance lineage and deterministic compatibility findings.
Project/template remix or fork lineage remains explicit and provenance-preserving rather than replacing source ownership history.
Provider-off/local operation remains valid for supported local documented formats and no undocumented reverse-engineered dependency is required.
SAA-30 terminal professional/collaborative golden proof remains unauthorized until verified SAA-29 closeout.
boundaries: SAA-29 owns interchange/roundtrip semantics only; canonical comic, ARI asset/provenance, Dialogue/text, renderer and other source-domain owners remain canonical.
No duplicate asset/provenance, page/panel/layer, Dialogue/text, Character, Scene, audio, renderer or narrative ledger may be created.

Private/proprietary formats require independently lawful documented support; no copying of proprietary code, assets, protected expression, undocumented protocols or private save formats is authorized.
Lossy or unsupported interchange semantics must be explicit and fail/degrade visibly rather than silently mutating canonical source state.
Export does not grant publication, distribution, provider upload or commercial release authority.
SAA-30 remains blocked until verified SAA-29 closeout.
next_action: Await a later explicit owner Continue before governed-starting SAA-29.
